title: Check a project against the house layout — check_project
text: rule finding prints one PASS line. finding prints one line: PASS|WARN|FAIL  <rule>  <detail>. count line comes last. Every rule reads one set files folders: path top folder git repository, set output git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard. tracked files, untracked files git ignore. Otherwise, set every file folder disk. sets leave .DS_Store, .Rhistory, .RData, Word lock files ~$*, everything .git/ .Rproj.user/. rules: lower_case_names (FAIL): file folder name capital letter. Everything background/ checked. exempt: README.md, CHANGELOG.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, DESCRIPTION, top-level dotfile, top-level *.Rproj file, file extensions, initials manuscript/manual/vNN_<INITIALS>.docx. run_script_initialises (FAIL): vNN_run.R top level call pbn::initialize_project() whose version argument string "vNN". detail names argument call initialize_project() . no_active_use_scenario (FAIL): vNN_run.R top level call pbn::use_scenario() use_scenario(), reference pbn::use_scenario, comment. call inside function body counts. use_scenario() stepping script hand. use_scenario_lines (FAIL): vNN_run.R top level exactly one comment # pbn::use_scenario("<name>", sim = 1) scenario CFG$scenarios. comment another scenario fails . detail names scenario, number lines one. rule check order. comment counts hold: first call pbn::initialize_project(). top level script, function body braced block . thing line. sim = 1. whitespace parts allowed. rule WARN reason script call pbn::initialize_project(), pbn read CFG$scenarios. version_items_complete (FAIL): vNN_run.R vNN_functions/, reverse. results_contract (FAIL): vNN_results/<scenario>/results.qs2 vNN_results/<scenario>/sim_NNNN/results.qs2 fails check_results(), results.qs2 directly vNN_results/. scenario_checks (FAIL): vNN_results/<scenario>/check.csv value pass TRUE. run_scenarios() writes files. manual_manuscript_names (FAIL): file manuscript/manual/ match ^v[0-9]{2}_[-Z]{2,4}[0-9]?\.docx$. manuscript_reads_real (FAIL): .R, .qmd .Rmd file manuscript/built/ calls read_results() pbn::read_results() scenario argument string "real". call without scenario passes. .qmd .Rmd files, rule reads R chunks knitr::purl() extracts inline R code. no_local_copy_of_pbn_function (FAIL): top-level assignment vNN_functions/*.R file defines function name pbn export. loc_per_file (FAIL): .R file 1000 code lines, counted org::loc_per_file(). no_environment_variables (FAIL): run script file functions folder uses Sys.getenv Sys.setenv. unknown_path (WARN): house layout name top-level file folder. layout names vNN_run.R, vNN_functions/, vNN_results/, vNN_test/, vNN_check_functions.R, check_project.R run_scenarios.R, among others. top-level dotfile top-level *.Rproj file never unknown. R parser, regular expression, finds calls, assignments symbols. check_project() runs project code. read CFG$scenarios rule use_scenario_lines, sources vNN_functions/ folder vNN_run.R org::initialize_project() new R session, run_scenarios() . top-level call files runs , example call writes file. file pbn_allow.txt project folder MAY list exceptions. Write one rule<TAB>path per line, path relative project folder. allowed finding prints WARN, (allowed) end. entry matches finding prints WARN rule pbn_allow.

code: home <- file.path(tempdir(), "pbn_check_example") dir.create(file.path(home, "v01_functions"), recursive = TRUE) writeLines(   'pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", home = ".", data_raw = "x")',   file.path(home, "v01_run.R") ) pbn::check_project(home) #> PASS  lower_case_names  no capital letter in a name #> PASS  run_script_initialises  every vNN_run.R calls pbn::initialize_project() with its own version #> PASS  no_active_use_scenario  no vNN_run.R has an active call pbn::use_scenario() #> WARN  use_scenario_lines  v01_run.R: pbn cannot read CFG$scenarios: CFG$scenarios in v01_functions/ must be a data.frame with the columns scenario and sims. #> PASS  version_items_complete  every vNN_run.R has a vNN_functions/, and the reverse #> PASS  results_contract  every vNN_results/<scenario>/results.qs2 and vNN_results/<scenario>/sim_NNNN/results.qs2 passes check_results() #> PASS  scenario_checks  every vNN_results/<scenario>/check.csv passes #> PASS  manual_manuscript_names  every file in manuscript/manual/ is named vNN_<INITIALS>.docx #> PASS  manuscript_reads_real  manuscript/built/ reads only the real results #> PASS  no_local_copy_of_pbn_function  no vNN_functions/ file defines a pbn export #> PASS  loc_per_file  no .R file has more than 1000 code lines #> PASS  no_environment_variables  no Sys.getenv or Sys.setenv in a run script or a functions folder #> PASS  unknown_path  the house layout names every top-level path #> 12 PASS, 1 WARN, 0 FAIL  unlink(home, recursive = TRUE)
